findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/story-create.ts:413 The fromDraft branch returns before the new repro-first story_create preflight is defined/invoked. It reads draft index/checklist, computes riskSignals, writes the INIT story/checklist, deletes the draft, commits metadata, and returns at line 538 without calling classifyReproFirstRequirement or honoring reproFirstPreflight.mode=enforce. A reviewed draft whose checklist JSON contains files.modify/create/test, or whose index is type=bug / high-risk code-verifiable, can therefore be materialized by story_create --fromDraft without an accepted story-evidence-binding and without reproFirstBypassReason. That violates the pre-story story_create intake contract; later PLAN/DEV gates may catch it, but the creation-time gate is bypassed on this supported story_create surface.
